text: 中年人的两套体系。
en: The two systems of the middle-aged.

text: 第一，既然是中年人，就不需要别人来敲打自己了。
en: First, as a middle-aged person, you no longer need others to knock some sense into you.

text: 该和不该心里都应该有数。
en: You should have a clear sense in your heart of what is right and what is not.

text: 第二，作为一个中年人。
en: Second, as a middle-aged person.

text: 更应该明白。
en: You should understand all the more.

text: 不要去敲打别人。
en: Do not go knocking sense into others.

text: 人不是被叫醒的，而是他自己觉醒的。
en: A person is not roused by others, but awakens of their own accord.

text: 一位女网友，快四十岁了，立志转行，一次性通过了司法考试。
en: A female netizen, nearly forty, resolved to change careers and passed the judicial exam in a single sitting.

text: 考试之后需要找律所实习。
en: After the exam, she needed to find a law firm for an internship.

text: 托亲靠友，找到了律所。
en: Relying on relatives and friends, she found a law firm.

text: 主任和她谈话时说：来实习，是欢迎的，但，不会有师傅带。
en: When the firm's senior partner spoke with her, he said: you are welcome to come and intern, but there will be no mentor to guide you.

text: 年轻律师，是有师傅带的，因为他们年轻，学习能力强，也能做点儿杂事。
en: Young lawyers are assigned mentors, because they are young, learn quickly, and can also run a few errands.

text: 但年纪大的律师，就没有人带了，带不动，教不了，很多成熟律师都还不到四十岁，比你还小，他们没法指挥比自己年长的人干活。
en: But older lawyers have no one to guide them; they cannot be led, cannot be taught. Many seasoned lawyers are still under forty, younger than you, and they cannot order someone older than themselves to do the work.

text: 主任甚至还举了个例子：就像谈恋爱，也没人愿意和年纪大的人谈。
en: The senior partner even gave an example: just like dating, no one is willing to be with an older person.

text: 所以，三个月时间，你自己眼观六路、耳听八方，找活干，找能见缝插针的案子，找到了，能在这一行站住了，欢迎留下来。
en: So, in these three months, you must keep your eyes and ears open, find work to do, find cases where you can wedge yourself in. If you find them and can establish yourself in this line of work, you are welcome to stay.

text: 找不到，那…
en: If you cannot, then…

text: 她只觉得：人生中路，进退维谷。
en: She only felt: midway through life's journey, caught in a dilemma with no way forward or back.

text: 而我的想法是：往前走，自己成全自个儿。
en: Yet my view is: press on, and fulfil yourself by your own efforts.

text: 中年转行是一个普遍现象，而转行之后，往往都面临同一个问题：
en: Changing careers in middle age is a common phenomenon, and after changing careers one often faces the same problem:

text: 新的行业，需要新的资源——资源何来？
en: A new industry calls for new resources — where are those resources to come from?

text: 新的规则需要理解——谁来讲解？
en: New rules must be understood — who will explain them?

text: 迫不及待想寻找一个指路的人。
en: You are impatient to find someone to show you the way.

text: 但这个人，是找不到的。
en: But this person cannot be found.

text: 这样的困境我也遇不到。
en: Such a predicament, I too shall not encounter.

text: 纸媒崩盘之后，从业人员面临重新洗牌的问题。
en: After the print media collapsed, those in the trade faced the problem of a complete reshuffle.

text: 说起来，写作是个手艺，有这个，哪里都可以混饭吃，但，究竟要用什么方式进入到新的行业？
en: To be honest, writing is a craft; with it you can scrape a living anywhere, but by what means exactly does one break into a new industry?

text: 那时，很多人面临的窘境就是：有很多疑问，但不知道该问谁。
en: At that time, the awkward predicament many faced was this: they had many questions, yet did not know whom to ask.

text: 问了，人家也不说，敷衍你几句了是——都是吃饭的本事，告诉你，他自己饿死吗？
en: If you asked, they would not tell you, only fobbing you off with a few words — these are their bread-and-butter skills; tell you, and would they not starve?

text: 带更是不可能的。
en: And mentoring you is out of the question entirely.

text: 你不是纯真的年轻人，能学徒一段时间，对他言听计从，出师之后还一生当他是老师。
en: You are not a naive young person who can apprentice for a spell, obey without question, and treat him as a master for life once trained.

text: 你不是全懂但你也不是完全不懂，你有主意有想法，你不会忍受别人的脾气，而且你也无法与对方建立长久坚定的感情关系。
en: You do not understand everything, yet you are not wholly ignorant either; you have your own opinions and ideas, you will not tolerate another's temper, and moreover you cannot form a lasting, firm emotional bond with the other party.

text: 四十岁之后甚至三十岁之后，很多人已经无法在心里把其他人视为老师了。
en: After forty, even after thirty, many people can no longer regard others in their hearts as teachers.

text: 一生都是在其他人指导下生活：
en: A lifetime of living under the guidance of others:

text: 上学，有老师；
en: At school, there are teachers;

text: 上班，有前辈；
en: At work, there are those who came before;

text: 婚恋，听父母的；
en: In marriage and romance, you listen to your parents;

text: 到了中层，上面还有高层。
en: Once you reach middle management, above you there are still those in senior management.

text: 而到此刻——完全没有人指导你了。
en: But at this moment — there is absolutely no one to guide you.

text: 工作，生活，学习，全部的全部，这就是你前半生抱怨着、梦寐以求的自由，你快乐吗？
en: Work, life, learning — all of it. This is the freedom you grumbled about and dreamt of through all your earlier years. Are you happy?

text: 实话实说：就像一个人被扔在黄沙滚滚的旷野里，没有手机没有地图没有同行者。
en: To tell the truth: it is like a person thrown into a vast wilderness of rolling yellow sand, with no phone, no map, no companions.

text: 前方有许多条人走出来的小路，你有无限选择，但你就是不知道哪条才能通往绿洲。
en: Ahead lie many narrow paths trodden out by people; you have infinite choices, yet you simply do not know which one leads to the oasis.

text: 很可能，你走到中间，就死于口渴、脱水、毒虫、强盗…
en: Very likely, you will die halfway — of thirst, dehydration, venomous insects, bandits…

text: 这才是真正的“人生是旷野”。
en: This is the true 'life is a wilderness'.

text: 怎么 办？
en: What is to be done?

text: 这时候，需要调动你前半生所有的学识与能力。
en: At this point, you must mobilise all the knowledge and ability you gathered in your earlier years.

text: 你文字功力强吗？
en: Do you have a strong command of writing?

text: 你口才好吗？
en: Are you eloquent?

text: 你会交朋友吗？
en: Can you make friends?

text: 你人脉宽广吗？
en: Do you have extensive connections?

text: 你观察力强吗？
en: Do you have a strong power of observation?

text: 能否立刻看出新单位的派系。
en: Can you immediately spot the factions in the new workplace?

text: 甚至，你阅读能力强吗？
en: Moreover, are you a strong reader?

text: 密密麻麻的合同里，有很多陷阱，你认得出吗？
en: In densely packed contracts there are many traps — can you recognise them?

text: 你身体好吗？
en: Are you in good health?

text: 你能加班吗？
en: Can you work overtime?

text: 还需要锻炼你所有前半生不擅长的东西。
en: You must also practise the things you were never good at in your earlier years.

text: 你一生都社恐，但这时可能需要每晚在镜前反复练习；
en: You have been socially anxious all your life, yet now you may need to rehearse before the mirror every night;

text: 你讨厌开会，但你别无选择；
en: You hate meetings, but you have no choice;

text: 有时候你得据理力争，有时候你得接受失败。
en: Sometimes you must argue your case vigorously, sometimes you must accept defeat.

text: 你可能被冷遇，你才知道，之前你以为理所当然的事，只是年龄红利。
en: You may be given the cold shoulder, and only then realise that what you once took for granted was merely the dividend of age.

text: 你可能被直接拒绝，你才发现，有些你以为天经地义的事，只是之前，你在大平台，那是平台红利。
en: You may be flatly rejected, and only then discover that some things you thought were matters of course were, back then, simply the platform dividend — because you were on a large platform.

text: 所有的红利，当你身在其中时，你都不会发现。
en: All such dividends, while you are immersed in them, go unnoticed.

text: 当你意识到它们的存在，你已经没有红利了。
en: When you become aware of their existence, you no longer have the dividends.

text: 那么，到这个年纪，你还有什么样的红利？
en: So, at this age, what dividends do you still have?

text: 照我说：还是有的。
en: As I see it: there are still some.

text: 你有之前职业累积下来的人脉；
en: You have the connections accumulated from your previous career;

text: 你有在生活和工作中学习的情商；
en: You have the emotional intelligence learned in life and work;

text: 你的心智已经成熟，你的身体还未老去。
en: Your mind is already mature, your body not yet aged.

text: 相应的，最忌讳的就是“大龄幼稚”。
en: In turn, what is most to be avoided is 'naivety of later age'.

text: 你还是会像年轻人一样，时时觉得委屈，觉得：人家是第一次，人家是新手，你得给人家一点点时间。
en: You still, like a young person, feel wronged from time to time, thinking: they are new to this, they are a novice, you must give them a little time.

text: 那些我不愿意做的事，我需要时间来接受。
en: The things I am unwilling to do, I need time to come to terms with.

text: 那些你希望我做的事，我需要时间来学习。
en: The things you wish me to do, I need time to learn.

text: 我一定会完成所有的需求，但我需要时间。
en: I will certainly fulfil all the requirements, but I need time.

text: ——别了别了。
en: — Enough, enough.

text: 这是“年龄+性别”红利，仅限30岁之下的女性。
en: This is the 'age + gender' dividend, limited to women under thirty.

text: 无论是工作还是恋爱中，男性，30岁之上的女性，一旦出现这个作派，就够让人望风而逃的了。
en: Whether at work or in relationships, men — and women over thirty — once they display this sort of behaviour, are enough to make others turn tail and flee.

text: 少女心可以收收了。
en: It is time to put away that girlish heart.

text: 还有一个也很糟糕的，就是“未老先衰”。
en: There is another, equally dreadful one: 'growing old before your time'.

text: 你会像老年人一样，经常疑虑重重：这行吗？
en: You will be like an old person, constantly full of misgivings: will this work?

text: 这对吗？
en: Is this right?

text: 非得这么做或者不能这么做吗？
en: Must it be done this way, or can it not be done this way?

text: 都用A系统？
en: Do they all use System A?

text: 可是我原来用过B系统，比A系统好用…
en: But I used System B before, which was easier to use than System A…

text: 当然了，听您的。
en: Of course, whatever you say.

text: 领导你这是PUA,别看我是新来的，我当年单位里领导比你还SB。
en: Boss, this is PUA. Don't be fooled by the fact that I'm new — the boss at my old unit was an even bigger SB than you.

text: 我懂，听您的，我也不懂。
en: I understand, I'll do as you say, though I don't really understand either.

text: 那不行，我有我的原则。
en: That won't do, I have my principles.

text: 是的，我会听您的。
en: Yes, I will listen to you.

text: 但我有我的原则。
en: But I have my principles.

text: ——也歇了吧。
en: — That too should be dropped.

text: 这是”成就+甲方“红利，仅限愿意给钱的成功人士。
en: This is the 'achievement + client' dividend, available only to successful people willing to pay.

text: 同样，无论是工作还是恋爱中，你不愿意给钱，你不成功，你都省省你的”爹味“了。
en: Similarly, whether at work or in relationships, if you won't pay and you aren't successful, you'd best drop that 'father-knows-best' manner of yours.

text: 总之，中年人，不是少女不是爹，是脚踏实地的中年人。
en: In short, the middle-aged person is neither a maiden nor a father, but a down-to-earth middle-aged person.

text: 自个儿成全自己。
en: Fulfil yourself by your own efforts.

text: 在旷野里走出自己的路。
en: Walk out your own path in the wilderness.

text: 中年人应该明白，不要去敲打别人。
en: The middle-aged should understand: do not go knocking sense into others.

text: 所以作为中年人的我有两套话语体系。
en: So, as a middle-aged person, I have two systems of discourse.

text: 遇到有人请教，对方如果是自强自立的人，就把自己的过程展示，主打“你也可以做到”。
en: When someone comes seeking advice, if they are the self-reliant type, I lay out my own process, centred on 'you can do this too'.

text: 对方如果只是一个想找借口的人，马上承认他嘴中的对我的解释，“你就是有钱有闲”“你就是家庭（爹妈伴侣）给力”“你就是天赋运气好”，立正挨打，绝不辩论。
en: If the other person is merely someone hunting for excuses, immediately accept the explanations they voice about me — 'you're simply wealthy and have time', 'your family (parents, partner) simply backs you up', 'you simply have talent and luck' — stand to attention and take the beating, never arguing back.

text: 年轻的时候是真做不到。
en: When I was young, I genuinely could not do this.

text: 经常长篇大论，深信所有人只要付出自己同样的努力，也可以拿到结果。
en: I would often hold forth at length, convinced that anyone who exerted the same effort as me could also get results.

text: 不厌其烦的告诉对方，要按照ABC这样的步骤，然后走DEF这样路径，如果遇到了GHI的变化，你就用JKL的谋略，该付出的要付出，该放弃的要放弃…
en: I would patiently tell the other person, over and over, that they must follow steps such as ABC, then take a path such as DEF; if they meet with changes such as GHI, they should employ the strategy of JKL — pay what must be paid, abandon what must be abandoned…

text: 话没说完，对方已经晕了，“太长不看”。
en: Before I had finished, the other person was already overwhelmed: 'too long, won't read'.

text: 然后他们还会总结，你能做到是因为“你就是身体好，你就是能吃苦，你就是家庭条件好，你就是有天赋”。
en: Then they would conclude that the reason you can do it is: 'you're simply in good health, you simply can bear hardship, you simply come from a good family, you simply have talent'.

text: 气得我经常辩论。
en: It infuriated me, and I would often argue back.

text: 也不知道过了多久，终于想明白了。
en: I don't know how much time went by, but I finally understood.

text: 我就是要承认他们说的话，这样大家都有台阶下。
en: I just need to concede what they say, so that everyone has a graceful way to back down.

text: 他又没给我钱，干嘛要去做普度众生的事。
en: He hasn't paid me, so why should I go playing saviour to the masses.

text: 然后学会了改口“对对对，你就是原生家庭拖累了你，就是你老公老婆不给力，就是你孩子太叛逆，就是领导不理解你，就是环境运气对你不利，” …
en: Then I learned to change my wording: 'yes yes yes, it's your family of origin that held you back, your husband or wife simply doesn't pull their weight, your child is too rebellious, your boss simply doesn't understand you, your circumstances and luck are simply against you'…

text: 皆大欢喜。
en: And all are satisfied.

text: 你以为这芸芸众生，有几个人真的在找解决方案？
en: Do you think, of these teeming multitudes, how many are actually looking for a solution?

text: 有几个人真的为自己的人生在负责？
en: How many are truly taking responsibility for their own lives?

text: 真话难听还得罪人，你说完了，他就不得不复盘反省，面对自己的短板，那是非常痛苦的事；又或者表面他听进去了，回头对你避而不见，费力不讨好，这就是巅峰。
en: Honest words are hard to hear and give offence; once you have spoken, he is forced to review and reflect, confronting his own shortcomings — a deeply painful process. Or else he seems to take it in, only to avoid you thereafter — effort spent for no gratitude; that is the very pinnacle.

text: 不如帮他解脱，找一个存在的理由。
en: Better to help set him free, by finding him a reason to exist.
